posts.name: TenTags API & AI generate
posts.tagline: API-first document generation for HTML, PDF, XLSX & DOCX
posts.description: TenTags API turns declarative Style/Data CSV templates into HTML, PDF, XLSX, or DOCX files through one authenticated endpoint. Build and preview templates in the web playground, then generate documents remotely from any backend or CLI.

posts.name: Zero: Budget with Zero
posts.tagline: Local-first zero-based budgeting, no bank connection
posts.description: Zero is a local-first, zero-based budgeting app for people who prefer not to connect their bank. Core budgeting screens read from an on-device database for immediate interactions, while confirmed changes sync across your devices. It is local-first, not offline-only: saving pauses while fully disconnected. Enter transactions manually or import from YNAB, Actual Budget, or CSV. Use targets, schedules, spending, and net-worth insights. Try every feature free for 34 days—no card required.

posts.name: agentrecap
posts.tagline: Simple tool to analyze your local coding-agent sessions
posts.description: Simple tool to analyze your local coding-agent sessions. Gives you data beyond cost, including run durations, tool calls made, lines of code touched, messages per thread etc.

posts.name: ota.gg
posts.tagline: Your anime watchlist, one link
posts.description: Your anime list as a page you'd actually share. Watching, watchlist, watched, at ota.gg/yourname. Free, no ads.

posts.name: Populr — your CMO
posts.tagline: Streamline your marketing, amplify your impact
posts.description: Populr is a marketing automation platform designed to simplify marketing efforts for businesses. It connects with your website, Google Analytics, and Search Console to learn about your business and revenue streams. With Populr, businesses can automate daily marketing tasks, such as SEO, social media, and management. By using AI-powered agents, Populr helps businesses save time and increase their online visibility, all while keeping the business owner in control of the marketing strategy

posts.name: Sportgraphics
posts.tagline: Animated social media graphics for your team in an instant.
posts.description: Clubs of every size need match day content but a majority of them have no in house designers. SportGraphics fixes that for soccer: set up your crest, colours and roster once, then turn any match moment — match day, goal, lineup, substitution, full time — into a branded graphic in seconds. Pro level designs, exported as animated MP4 or a still, in square and story sizes. Not an AI generator: real templates rendered from your real squad data, so the details are always right.

posts.name: Loamnote
posts.tagline: Carefully tuned notes for quieter focus
posts.description: Loamnote is a free focus sound app blending soft noise, layered notes, subtle movement, and binaural frequencies. Choose a soundscape, press play, and settle into work. Includes flexible timers, Pomodoro mode, on-device sound generation, and offline use.

posts.name: RepoAI.io
posts.tagline: The security-scored directory for MCP servers
posts.description: RepoAI is a directory for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — the plugins connecting Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and other AI tools to your files, databases, and APIs. Every one of 213 listed servers gets a 0-100 security score from 15+ signals, a ready-to-paste config for 5 AI clients, and a verdict written by a human editor — never scraped, never AI marketing copy. Browse 36 categories or jump straight to Best MCP servers for your client. No paid placements, ever.

posts.name: Dailo: Tabs and Bookmarks
posts.tagline: A bookmarks and tabs manager built for productivity
posts.description: Dailo is a free, local-first tab manager and focus extension for Chrome and Firefox. Turn open tabs into calm Spaces, snooze links, and focus from one shortcut. Comes with a fully customizable new tab page which shows your saved links, spaces, tasks and sticky notes that you can stick anywhere. Fully keyboard accessible.

posts.name: LaunchStack
posts.tagline: AI spins up your stack for you
posts.description: LaunchStack is a brand new software for Vibe Coders which automates some of the most commonly used resources you need, like GitHub, Vercel, Supabase and Railway. So instead of manually going to each site every time you start a new project, LaunchStack does it all from your desktop. (Mobile apps coming soon) All you do is create tokens for each of the services you want to use, save them in the app (They don't leave your device) and LaunchStack does the rest.

posts.name: CstWeave
posts.tagline: Snip any tab region to GIF & HD WebM. 100% on-device.
posts.description: The fastest, most private tab region recorder. Draw a rectangle over any tab, export clean GIFs or HD WebM videos with system audio 100% on-device. No cloud uploads, no server rendering queues, no watermarks. Powered by Chrome Offscreen Documents for zero tab lag. Lite is free forever; Pro is $9.99 lifetime.

posts.name: Waivly Deals - Savings On What You Use
posts.tagline: Exclusive and curated offers on the things you use daily
posts.description: Exclusive offers and curated savings from carefully selected partners. New benefits are added regularly. Looking for something specific? Reach out to the concierge desk.

posts.name: Inventorily
posts.tagline: Free, private inventory labels & barcode tags
posts.description: Upload Excel or CSV files and generate printable inventory labels, barcode tags, warehouse rack labels, and asset tags in minutes. All processing happens in your browser — no uploads, no account required, completely free to start. 🔒 100% browser-based (your data never leaves your computer) 🏷️ 7+ label formats Avery, A4, Zebra, shelf tags 📊 Supports Code128, UPC-A, EAN-13, QR, Data Matrix 📸 Photo inventory reports for insurance & audits ✅ Built-in CSV validator to catch errors before printing

posts.name: Loora
posts.tagline: The agent design harness
posts.description: Loora helps teams and AI agents create consistent interfaces with reusable components, design systems, and UI patterns.

posts.name: WeLike
posts.tagline: WeLike, an AI Marketing Assistant designed for all marketers
posts.description: Marketing tools and playbooks, battle-tested across 100+ frontier tech launches: KOL pricing, social listening, AI news, and smart alerts for AI builders.

posts.name: HealthVItals Pro
posts.tagline: Insights from your Apple Health data
posts.description: Turn everything in Apple Health into clear, personal insight. Sleep, heart, movement, and recovery, understood. Fully private, all on your device.

posts.name: In10Years
posts.tagline: Write now. Meet this version of you years from today.
posts.description: In10Years is a private letter to your future self. Write in a calm space, choose an exact delivery date, and seal the message so even you cannot reread it. Email delivery is free, with an optional printed keepsake later.

posts.name: VideoCompress
posts.tagline: Compress video in your browser — free, private, no upload
posts.description: VideoCompress shrinks MP4, MOV & WebM right in your browser — nothing is uploaded, so your video never leaves your device. Hit an exact size (10MB for Discord, 25MB for email) or pick a quality preset. Free, no sign-up, no watermark, no file-size limit.

posts.name: whatbroke
posts.tagline: Diff two agent runs and see exactly what changed
posts.description: Diffs two agent runs and shows which tool calls fired, how the arguments differed, what each run cost, and where the outputs diverged. Reads JSONL, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse and LangSmith exports. Run it in CI and fail the build on a dropped call.

posts.name: The Check
posts.tagline: Restaurant fees and tipping pressure, reported by visitors
posts.description: Surprise service charges, 'wellness' fees, guilt-trip tip screens — The Check shows what a spot really charges before you go. Search any restaurant, bar, or cafe to see its fees and tipping norms, reported by real diners. Spot a sneaky fee on your bill? Add a report in 30 seconds and help the next person. Browse it all on a map, on web or iOS. We're not anti-restaurant or anti-tipping. Just pro-knowing-before-you-sit-down. No shaming, no drama.

posts.name: dev101.io
posts.tagline: One box for every dev utility — runs in your browser
posts.description: Privacy-first, keyboard-driven hub for 50+ dev tools: format, encode, hash, diff, convert, generate, inspect — all in one place, 100% client-side.  Format JSON, decode JWTs, hash strings, convert timezones, build regex — 62 tools in one box. Transforms run in your browser, so your data never leaves the tab. No ads, no signup, no uploads. ⌘K to jump to any tool. Installable, works offline. Free.

posts.name: Universal Data Platform
posts.tagline: Replace Excel & WhatsApp with a unified data dashboard
posts.description: Universal Data Platform is a serverless, browser-based dashboard that replaces scattered Excel and WhatsApp workflows. It centralizes data collection for regional network managers (restaurants, retail) into one unified platform accessible via a simple link.

posts.name: LapDeck
posts.tagline: Your phone, a remote deck for your Windows laptop
posts.description: Turn any phone into a remote deck for your Windows laptop: app launcher, touchpad, keyboard, live screen view, media & power controls — all over your own Wi-Fi. One npm start, no cloud, no accounts, optional Tailscale for remote access.

posts.name: Sparcam
posts.tagline: Camera-powered cardio games in your browser
posts.description: Fun cardio games in your browser. No equipment — just you and your camera. Punch, swing, slice, duck. Video never leaves your device.Sparcam turns your webcam into cardio games. On-device pose detection scores real punches, swings and slices — no equipment, no install, no uploads. Boxing, Tennis and Slicer run in a browser tab, free in early access. Camera frames never leave your device.
